description: Defines the StringAtom class, which models a pointer to a globally unique constant string, with various comparison, hashing, and conversion functionalities. It is used for efficient string key handling in containers within the GN build system.

classes.name: StringAtom
classes.description: A class representing a pointer to a globally unique constant string, supporting comparison, hashing, and conversions.

methods.name: StringAtom()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes value to a globally unique empty string.

methods.name: StringAtom(std::string_view str) noexcept
methods.description: Constructs a StringAtom from a string view.

methods.name: SameAs(const StringAtom& other) const
methods.description: Checks if this StringAtom is the same key as another based on pointer equality.

methods.name: operator==(const StringAtom& other) const
methods.description: Checks if two StringAtoms have the same string value.

methods.name: operator!=(const StringAtom& other) const
methods.description: Checks if two StringAtoms have different string values.

methods.name: hash() const
methods.description: Returns a hash of the string value.

methods.name: ptr_hash() const
methods.description: Returns a hash based on the pointer to the string.
